mechanism: Meloxicam (NSAID) reduces renal perfusion and may impair ceftazidime clearance while increasing risk of acute kidney injury; ceftazidime may increase meloxicam levels through competitive renal tubular secretion inhibition.
action: Monitor renal function (SCr, BUN) before and during concurrent use; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative antibiotic or NSAID if renal impairment develops; use lowest effective meloxicam dose.
